evidence.formulaExplanation: Score = 70% of the population-weighted mean + 30% of the weakest district score − the number of indicators below 40. All values are model points.
evidence.ties: All districts tied at the minimum are listed.
evidence.districtFormula: A district score sums its ten indicator values multiplied by their weights. Each weight is shown below.
evidence.populationWeights: Population shares used for the mean
evidence.horizon: The horizon is 8 quarters. Realized effect = full effect × (8 − lag) / 8.
evidence.thresholdRule: The critical threshold is strictly below 40. A value of 40 carries no penalty.
evidence.clippingRule: After effects and synergies are added, the value is clipped to 0–100. Synergies are added in full.
evidence.attributionExplanation: Exact calculation across 32 subsets averages each measure’s contribution over all 120 addition orders. It accounts for synergies, clipping to 0–100, weakest-district switches and penalties. This allocates a model change; it does not establish real-world causality. Subsets are diagnostics, not valid plans.
evidence.rounding: Unrounded contributions sum to final minus baseline Score. Displayed values are rounded.
evidence.attributionUnavailable: Choose five valid measures within budget to see the contribution allocation.
evidence.emptySearch: No measures found. Change the search or direction.
evidence.m11Warning: M11 trade-off: safety improves, but congestion indicator T1 falls by 1.75 points over the model horizon.
evidence.unlockFirst: First unlock the measure being replaced in priorities or the catalogue.

workshop.priorityHint: Set search conditions. They are saved with your plan.
workshop.directHint: Direct investments are targeted measures in chosen districts. City-wide benefits are counted separately and do not increase this number.
workshop.lockHint: A lock preserves both the measure and its district in every result.
workshop.comparisonHint: Changes are relative to the first selected version. These are evaluations from one model, not forecasts.
workshop.requestFailed: The request failed. Your inputs are preserved; retry the action.
workshop.saveFirst: Wait for changes to save or resolve the version conflict first.
workshop.localPreserved: The version changed while you edited. Your changes remain in the editor; choose a version in the conflict message.
workshop.forked: Copy “{title}” saved in your plan library.
workshop.searchHint: An exact search through valid decisions, without an AI request. Your plan changes only when you choose Apply.
workshop.priceHint: Compare two searches: with and without this condition. All other limits, locks and the objective remain identical.
workshop.incomplete: Search incomplete — optimality is not proven
workshop.stale: Results belong to an earlier version or conditions. Run a new search to apply them; an earlier result can still be saved as a copy.
workshop.constraintConflict: Check condition: {code}. Edit that priority and rerun the search.
workshop.infeasible: No valid plan meets these conditions. Edit a condition above and search again. Conditions are never relaxed automatically.
workshop.priceEvidence: Compares the best results found in both searches. An incomplete search does not establish an optimality cost.
workshop.compareHint: Choose up to three versions from results, history or the current plan. Selection is retained in this tab.
workshop.historyHint: Restoring creates a new version and keeps previous decisions in history.
workshop.issue_LOCK_EXCLUDED: Measure {measureId} is both locked and excluded. Remove the lock or exclusion.
workshop.issue_LOCK_SPEND: Locked measures exceed your budget of {maxSpend}. Raise the ceiling or unlock a measure.

workshop.visualLegend: Each row compares one metric across all versions. District score bars use the same 0–100 scale; the dark marker is the first version’s value.

stress.title: What changes if costs rise or work is delayed?
stress.intro: Set a risk for one selected measure. Compare the original model with an experiment and find a plan that meets this specific condition.
stress.selectFirst: Add a measure to the plan first
stress.lagHint: Measure lag: {original} → {effective} quarters within the 8-quarter horizon. Delay cannot make the realized effect negative.
stress.assumptionLimit: This is your assumption, not a forecast or probability. Synergies remain fixed under model rules. The test applies only to this measure and risk.
stress.requestFailed: The request failed. Your inputs are preserved; retry the action.
stress.saveFirst: Wait for the plan to save or resolve the version conflict.
stress.defaultObjective: Find a valid plan under the same risk assumption, preserving all locks and other constraints. Explain the tradeoffs.
stress.localPreserved: The plan changed while the response arrived. Your edits are preserved; choose a version in the conflict message.
stress.stale: This experiment belongs to an earlier version. Repairs below preserve that version’s conditions. Run a new experiment for the current plan.
stress.invalid: The plan fails validation under this assumption. There is no valid Score; inspect the indicator values below.
stress.repairTitle: Repair the plan under the same risk
stress.repairHint: The search preserves the source locks, constraints, budget and assumption. It leaves the current plan unchanged. A valid repair may not exist.
stress.objective: What should be preserved or explained?
stress.waitingHint: Clarify your request above and run the analysis again. The experiment and saved candidates remain available.
stress.incomplete: Search incomplete; optimality is not proven
stress.infeasible: The complete search found no valid repair preserving all conditions. Change the source priorities and run a new experiment.
stress.riskRemoved: “{measure}” was replaced. This candidate avoids the tested risk because the risk was attached to that measure.
stress.applyHint: Applying transfers the decisions to the current plan. Its official Score is recalculated from original data; the experiment result is kept separately.

delivery.revokeHint: Revoking blocks new views and downloads. Previously downloaded files remain with recipients. Existing links cannot be recovered from this list.

delivery.sessionChanged: The session changed. Refresh the page to continue.
